maintenance.title: Veil is currently under maintenance.
maintenance.message: We're making improvements. Veil will be back shortly.

posts.title: Veil 3.0: pick your engine
posts.body:
Veil now has two engines and a new welcome screen.
- SCRAMJET: the newer engine, built for modern sites (ChatGPT's page now works with it)
- ULTRAVIOLET: the classic engine, still available
- Switch any time from Settings or the engine button on the home screen
- New Inbox (this page) for update notes

posts.title: Tab disguise
posts.body:
Make your browser tab look like another site.
- Settings > Tab disguise: type a site, press Apply
- Optional: use that site's name too
- The icon is fetched privately through Veil's tunnel

posts.title: AI button
posts.body: A new AI button on the home screen opens a free AI chat (no login) through Veil.

posts.title: Fixes for browser storage errors
posts.body:
- Fixed the "CacheStorage" error some browsers showed on start
- Fixed the "service worker aborted" error: Veil now retries and explains what to do
- Fixed the tab disguise crashing on the mirror pages
